source: CSV files written by the app (Exporter.kt) and copied into data/device_exports/, which is not committed
caveat: The phone decodes photographs to 3200 px on the long side; compare with desktop rows scored at the same resolution. error_vs_corners_pct is against the scale the placed corners imply and is only as true as they are; desktop_px_per_mm_error_vs_truth_pct is against the PTB-XL waveform, recomputed from each export's own trace.
